description: Three advertisements are proposed to the Hill Street elevation. Sign 01 is a fascia sign comprising fret-cut built-up aluminium lettering with 50mm returns, faces and returns finished white RAL 9003, fixed as separate components to a new powder-coated aluminium fascia panel finished blue RAL 5005. The lettering is retro-illuminated by concealed LED to the rear, giving a halo effect; the fascia panel itself is not illuminated and there is no illuminated panel, tray or box sign. Illumination will not exceed 300 cd/m2. Sign 02 is a non-illuminated projecting sign using the existing bracket, which is retained and repainted, with a new panel 780mm wide x 550mm high carrying a white logo on a blue RAL 5005 ground, with a minimum clearance of 2750mm from the footway to the underside of the sign. Sign 03 is a retractable folding-arm awning in blue RAL 5005 fabric with no valance, carrying non-illuminated white printed lettering reading ''AWARD WINNING FRESH ARTISAN GELATO'' on the sloping fabric; the underside of the front bar is a minimum of 2750mm above the footway when fully open. All three advertisements are shown on drawings 1138-A112 and 1138-A113.
